content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a couple of adjustments before signing. Specifically: - Regarding the clause stating that Intellectual property rights transfer to the client immediately upon creation rather than upon full payment, which creates a risk that you may not be paid for your work, I propose: Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Deliverables, the Contractor hereby assigns to the Client all right, title, and interest in such Deliverables. - Regarding the clause stating that Intellectual property ownership transfers to the client immediately upon creation as a work-made-for-hire, before you are guaranteed full payment, I propose: Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Deliverables, all Intellectual Property created by the Contractor in connection with the Deliverables shall become the property of the Client. Please let me know if these updates work for you so we can move forward. Best regards,
